g.text: S1 Kit: square-side waiting / reunion point.

g.text: S2 Tavern keeper: story, information, return anchor.

g.text: S3 Record / shrine service: history and Magic.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405044

g.text: S4 Smith / artificer: mechanisms, repairs and Tech.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405044

g.text: S5 River salvager: breath / climbing / endurance.

g.text: S6 Relic dealer: valuables and authored object choices.

g.text: Roles may combine; target 4–7 cast, not all at once.

g.text: Choose 2–3 interiors total; other doors read as closed.

g.text: North church and west gardens stay unmistakable.

g.text: Light pools and roof gaps lead into the central well.

g.text: Kit waits off the road; service points keep doors clear.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #405044

g.text: not this optional local millrace service bridge.
